name: California Partnership Academies (CPA)
what_you_do: You can join a three-year 'school within a school' for grades 10 to 12. It mixes academics with a career focus, business mentors and internships.
who_can_apply: Students at schools that host an academy. Each academy sets its own application. Search the school's website for 'Partnership Academy'.
pay_detail: The CDE page does not say whether internships pay or give school credit. Ask the school.
deadline_text: The CDE page lists no student application dates. Each school sets its own.
how_to_apply: Ask your counselor if your school has an academy. The CDE page links a directory of academies (a spreadsheet updated September 2026). The page does not say how students apply.
notes: Read the CDE page on 2026-10-09. It confirms a three-year program for grades 10 to 12, structured as a school-within-a-school, with academics plus career technical education, business partnerships, mentoring and internships. It posts only school and district grant dates, not student application dates, and does not say whether students from other districts may transfer in. Academies are run by individual schools, so ask your counselor. Fremont Unified says some CTE courses sit inside Partnership Academies.
